Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Research

A collection of mementos: weapons from old battles, mounted heads of slain creatures, trinkets taken from dungeons and ruins, and heirlooms passed down by ancestors.

Research Options. When you issue the Research order to this facility, choose one of the following.

Research: Lore. The hireling researches a legend, a kind of creature, or a famous object for 7 days (the trophies give clues on many subjects). They learn up to three accurate pieces of information you didn't know, chosen by the DM, and share them the next time you speak with them.

Research: Trinket Trophy. The hireling searches for a useful trinket for 7 days. Then roll any die: on an odd number, they find nothing useful; on an even number, they find a magic item, determined by rolling on the Implements—Common table of the Dungeon Master's Guide.
